question: Sangeeta observes the top of a chimney at an angle of elevation of 45°. She is standing 28.7 metres away from the base of the chimney, and her eye level is 1.3 metres above the ground. What is the total height (in metres) of the chimney?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For an angle of elevation of 45°, the height of the object above the observer's eye level is exactly equal to the horizontal distance.

Height of chimney above eye level = Horizontal distance = 28.7 m.

Total height of chimney = Height above eye level + Observer's eye level height.

Total height = 28.7 + 1.3 = 30 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 30 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance from the base of the chimney = 28.7 m

Angle of elevation = 45°

Observer's eye height = 1.3 m

**Formula Used:**

tan(θ) = Perpendicular ÷ Base

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the height of the chimney above the observer's eye level be h.

⇒ In the right-angled triangle formed by the line of sight, tan(45°) = h ÷ 28.7

⇒ 1 = h ÷ 28.7

⇒ h = 28.7 × 1 = 28.7 m

⇒ Total height of the chimney = Height above eye level + Observer's eye height

⇒ Total height = 28.7 + 1.3 = 30 m

**∴ The correct answer is 30 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Angle of Elevation

The angle formed by the line of sight with the horizontal when an observer looks upwards at an object.

Isosceles Right Triangle

A right-angled triangle with a 45° angle has equal perpendicular and base lengths since tan(45°) = 1.

Common Trigonometric Ratios

tan(30°) = 1 ÷ √3 | tan(45°) = 1 | tan(60°) = √3.
